description: Change a card's lifecycle status (PATCH /cards/v1/{id}): ACTIVE to unblock/activate, BLOCKED to freeze, DISABLED to cancel permanently. status_reason is required by Pomelo for blocks (e.g. CLIENT_INTERNAL_REASON, LOST, STOLEN).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Auto-generated when omitted.

name: update_card_status
